thread:
Maria G: heads-up — receiving a SEV escalation from a large hosted inference customer. They report ~40% 5xx rate and tail latencies spikes around 600–900ms from eu-west1a since ~09:03 UTC. Customer says failures started after a maintenance window on their side but we see network anomalies.
Samir K: thanks — can you paste the customer error samples? request ids?
Maria G: pasted below from their support ticket:
```
POST /v1/generate 500
x-request-id: r-3a7f2b
error: upstream gateway timeout
lat: 850ms
status: 502
```
Also seeing lots of `Upstream_connect_error` in our API gateway logs.
OpsBot: Incident created: INC-2300-NEU-BGP. Pager duty alerted @oncall.
Jen L: I'm looking at edge metrics — packet loss and retransmit delta on eu-west1a edge -> transit provider A starting 09:02 UTC. BGP flaps visible on provider peering: neighbor 198.51.100.12 OUT.
Luke P: can you drop the exact kernel qdisc counters or tcpdump snippet? want to rule out host NIC degredation.
Samir K: grabbing tcpdump from a healthy host and a victim host now. `sudo tcpdump -eni eth0 -c 200 'tcp and port 443' -w /tmp/eu1a.pcap`
Nicole H: traceroute from our gw to provider next-hop shows intermittent * * between hop 3 and 4 (transit).
Maria G: customer also reported auth 401s intermittently — likely secondary effect from retries and rate-limiter hitting auth backend timeouts. Not seeing token revocation.
Tarun R: adding networking oncall — @luke_p and @samir_k. I'll open a ticket with provider.
Samir K: quick comparison of gateway logs:
```
09:01:58 proxy-01 eu-west1a Upstream_connect_error id=r-3a7f2b
09:02:05 proxy-02 eu-west1a Upstream_connect_error id=r-3a7f2c
09:04:10 proxy-01 eu-west1b OK id=r-3a8fff
```
Pattern: eu-west1b unaffected.
Jen L: mitigation idea: fail eu-west1a traffic for that customer to eu-west1b via Smart Routing override (per-customer routing policy). Can we do quick failover?
Maria G: customer agreed to failover for traffic to avoid user impact. They want to keep eu-west1a for non-critical, but route production to eu-west1b.
Luke P: implementing routing override now — updating routing table for tenant t-9913 to prefer eu-west1b. Command:
```
redwood route update --tenant t-9913 --preferred-region eu-west1b --force
```
Samir K: provider responded: "we observed BGP session resets at 09:02 due to partial maintenance, full convergence took ~7m". Looks like micro-loss and path asymmetry.
OpsBot: Route update job 45312 started.
Maria G: after failover we see 5xx drop from 40% -> 3% for that customer's requests, tail latency back to ~120ms. Customer confirms improvement.
Nicole H: posting network excerpt for posterity:
```
09:02:01 BGP RCV Notification from 198.51.100.12: Peer reset
09:03:10 Interface eth3 rx_err 120 tx_err 0
09:04:00 RIB change: withdraw 203.0.113.0/24
```
Tarun R: filed provider escalation ticket #PROV-789 with their NOC and requested a timeline and root cause.
Samir K: action items:
- keep routing override for 24h then re-evaluate
- collect pcap and perf hist for postmortem
- update customer with RCA once provider confirms
- check if auth backend saw elevated latency causing 401s
Maria G: I'll handle customer comms: sent note that we failed production traffic to eu-west1b and are monitoring; will provide update in 1h. Added workaround steps and asked for any additional logs.
Support-Bot: Customer update queued to be sent at 09:27 UTC.
Jen L: we should also throttle retries in gateway for that tenant to avoid auth overload — temporary per-tenant retry backoff.
Luke P: applied retry-policy: `max_retries=1` for t-9913.
Nicole H: saving all artifacts to incident S3: s3://incidents/2300000000/ — pcaps, gateway logs, traceroutes.
Samir K: one more check — the uplift in egress RTT correlates with a different AS path through provider X. If provider's planned maintenance didn't drain customers gracefully, we need to capture their BGP adjacency logs.
Tarun R: provider sent preliminary note: "maintenance script inadvertently caused flapping on selective adjacencies; patch applied". They will deliver full RCA by EOD.
Maria G: current status: customer impact mitigated via region failover; provider working on permanent fix; oncall monitoring. Closing customer escalation if no regressions in 60m.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2300-NEU-BGP status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Maria G: filing postmortem draft and will tag eng-networking and eng-sre. Assigning follow-ups: 1) evaluate automatic cross-AZ failover thresholds, 2) add per-tenant retry/backoff capability to reduce auth cascade, 3) improve provider probe coverage for eu-west1a.
Samir K: thumbs up. Will attach traceroute + BGP dumps to postmortem.
Jen L: we should also run an offline traffic replay test to measure failover latency and token propagation.
Maria G: noted. Will coordinate with QE. Closing thread for now — will reopen if we see recurrence.
